verdict_reason: Official Meta documentation provides a public Graph API (Cloud API) with self-serve Meta app creation, a test number, and a temporary access token, plus documented webhooks and throughput. Production permissions may require App Review and delivered business-to-user messages are billed per message, but developer/test credentials are free and self-serve.
main_blocker: App Review for production permissions; per-message production billing
open_questions: The app name is ambiguous: WhatsApp Business (the small-business app) has no public API, while WhatsApp Business Platform/Cloud API does. Resolved to the Platform per the input hint, but this should be confirmed.
OAuth scopes/permissions documentation was not included in the supplied sources; only an App Review permissions reference was found. Need the official permissions page to confirm scope documentation.
Official SDK languages were not identified in the supplied evidence; the docs show raw HTTP/Graph API examples and mention a 'WhatsApp SDK' without listing supported languages.
Business verification or other production onboarding requirements are not described in the supplied sources and may gate production use beyond App Review.
Messaging limits and template messaging limits are referenced but the messaging-limits page was not included, so only throughput limits are captured.
No community MCP servers were found in the supplied evidence; the GitHub/MCP registry checks were empty, which may not be conclusive.
Composio catalog was searched only for 'WhatsApp Business'; a toolkit may exist under a different name such as 'WhatsApp'.
The documented test path consists of a temporary token, test number, and sample webhook server; no fully isolated sandbox environment is described.
On-Premises API sunset/deprecation details appeared only in search result titles, not in supplied source text.
